headline: Royal Caribbean, Carnival, Norwegian Cruise Line, American Airlines, and Delta Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know
summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after a sudden de-escalation in Middle East tensions sent global oil prices tumbling. headline: ROYAL CARIBBEAN GROUP REPORTS SECOND QUARTER RESULTS ABOVE EXPECTATIONS AND RAISES FULL YEAR GUIDANCE
summary: Royal Caribbean Group (NYSE: RCL) today reported second quarter Earnings per Share ("EPS") of $4.20 and Adjusted EPS of $4.21. These results were better than the company's guidance, driven by strong close-in demand, lower costs, and favorable performance from joint ventures. The company now expects full year Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $17.73 to $17.87. headline: Royal Caribbean Cruises (RCL) Rises With Oil Relief But Is The Valuation Already Priced In
summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises (RCL) is back on trader radars after easing conflict risks in the Middle East pushed oil prices lower, improving sentiment toward fuel intensive travel stocks as the company approaches its latest earnings update.
